title: Durability became a competitive advantage
subtitle: Days between maintenance doses for selected approved oligonucleotide drugs (U.S. labels).

items.label: patisiran (2018) · IV
items.detail: Lipid-nanoparticle siRNA given by intravenous infusion every 3 weeks.

items.label: givosiran (2019) · SC
items.detail: First GalNAc-conjugated siRNA; monthly subcutaneous injection.

items.label: vutrisiran (2022) · SC
items.detail: Next-generation GalNAc-siRNA for transthyretin amyloidosis; label expanded to cardiomyopathy in 2025.

items.label: plozasiran (2025) · SC
items.detail: APOC3 siRNA for familial chylomicronemia syndrome.

items.label: inclisiran (2021) · SC
items.detail: PCSK9 siRNA; after doses at day 0 and month 3, given every 6 months.

items.label: eplontersen (2023) · SC
items.detail: GalNAc-conjugated ASO for transthyretin amyloidosis polyneuropathy.

items.label: olezarsen (2024) · SC
items.detail: GalNAc-conjugated APOC3 ASO for familial chylomicronemia syndrome.

items.label: nusinersen (2016) · IT
items.detail: Intrathecal (spinal) injection; four loading doses, then every 4 months.
